backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app defining types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, Shloka, Temple, CommunityPost, Katha, etc.) and state maps, with mixins for blob storage and authorization, plus seeded Katha data for Ramayan and Mahabharat.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference for the project's frontend structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/.env.example: Documents that no API key configuration is needed since the Groq AI key is hardcoded in aiEngine.ts, and notes that VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY is no longer used.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, sidebar, and chart elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Reusable card component that renders a linked aarti item with an emoji icon, name, and styled border, navigating to the aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared app shell providing a sticky devotional header with Om logo and login button, main content outlet, bottom navigation, profile setup modal for new authenticated users, and a footer with Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with seven items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile) that highlights the active route with golden styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Chat bubble component that renders user or AI messages with avatar, timestamp, and basic markdown-like formatting for bold text and newlines.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Animated typing indicator component showing three bouncing dots with the AI guru avatar, displayed while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a daily dharma quote (Hindi and English) fetched via a query hook, with a fallback Bhagavad Gita quote and a skeleton loading state.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Shows a countdown card for the next upcoming Hindu festival fetched from an API, with a canvas-based shareable image download feature.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders animated floating lotus petal images as a fixed, non-interactive background decoration using CSS keyframe animations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing golden radial-gradient halo around its children, with configurable size presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a linked card for a Katha (story) with category badge, deity label, title, and a truncated Hindi text preview, styled differently for Puranik vs Vrat categories.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: A loading spinner component that displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and an optional text label.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, handling login state transitions and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen animated overlay that triggers on completing 108 japa counts, showing a lotus bloom image with petal burst particles and a celebratory message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on the count prop and slowly rotating the ring.
A short-lived particle burst animation that emits three Om symbols outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: A dismissible promotional banner advertising Sanatan Pro Premium subscription with a list of benefits and an upgrade call-to-action button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that prompts new users to enter their name to create a profile, saving it via the `useSetUserProfile` mutation with a default mantra set to `omNamahShivaya`.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on the screen when a numeric `trigger` prop changes, keeping up to 4 simultaneous ripples that fade out after 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Hindu shloka with Sanskrit text, Hindi and English meanings, and provides copy, share, and canvas-based image download actions.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard for fasting/vrat tracking that shows Brahma Muhurat time, a daily fasting check-in button, Navratri day progress, and countdown timers to Ekadashi and Maha Shivratri.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A simple toggle switch component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, displaying a label and description that update based on the current enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom hook managing AI chat state including message history, loading state, and input value, with `sendMessage` and `clearChat` functions that call `getAIResponse` with the last 6 messages as context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, jap counter stats, dharma quotes, festivals, kathas, and admin operations. Uses `useActor` and `useInternetIdentity` to gate queries on authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom hook wrapping the Web Speech API to play, pause, resume, and stop text-to-speech narration with Hindi voice preference and graceful fallback handling. Manages playback state and cleans up on component unmount.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for a devotional light/dark color theme (saffron, gold, maroon), and declaring keyframe animations for lotus floating, diya flickering, golden halo, and mandala spinning effects.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements a local spiritual AI response engine with predefined Hindi responses keyed by topic (meditation, mantra, dharma, Krishna, Shiva, yoga), with optional Groq API enhancement. Exposes a function that selects responses based on keyword matching in user input.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology AI guru feature, including rashi (zodiac) info for all 12 signs and prediction templates for love, career, and other life aspects in Hindi.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu religious stories (kathas) including full Hindi texts of Ramayan and Mahabharat with all major chapters, typed using the Katha and KathaCategory backend interfaces.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements accurate Hindu calendar (Panchang) calculations using Jean Meeus astronomical algorithms, computing sun/moon positions, Julian Day Numbers, and related values for IST timezone centered on Central India.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static data for Hindu religious content including Shloka and Aarti definitions, with full Hindi and English texts for Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, and other deity aartis.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that bootstraps the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Displays the full text of a specific aarti (by ID) with Hindi/English toggle, copy-to-clipboard, and native share functionality. Pulls aarti data from static data and shows a not-found state if the ID is invalid.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel that allows approving/rejecting user registrations, assigning user roles, and adding dharma quotes, gated behind Internet Identity authentication and an admin role check.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: React page component for an AI spiritual guru chat interface, featuring a message list, auto-resizing textarea input, suggested questions in Hindi, and scroll-to-bottom functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page showing seed posts with like/report actions, a compose dialog for authenticated users, and an approval-request flow for users who haven't been granted posting access yet.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated user dashboard that redirects unauthenticated visitors to home, shows a welcome message with the user's profile name, and triggers a profile-setup modal if no profile exists yet.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home screen featuring a hero section with a diya animation and greeting, today's panchang summary, a daily dharma quote, featured aartis, and upcoming festivals pulled from backend queries and static data.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) counter page with a selectable mantra list, per-session and lifetime tap counts synced to the backend, mala ring visualization, ripple/particle animations, and lotus bloom on every 108 completions.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Katha (Hindu story), displaying its Hindi/English text with language toggle, category badge, and speech narration controls using the Web Speech API. Falls back to static data if the backend query returns nothing.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Listing page for all Kathas with search input and category filter tabs (all, puranik, krishna, vrat), using backend data with a static fallback and rendering each item via KathaCard.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Temple finder page that provides a Google Maps deep-link to search nearby Hindu temples and displays a static list of famous Indian temples with live darshan and directions links.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Hindu calendar (Panchang) page showing daily tithi, nakshatra, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious timings for a user-navigable date, plus upcoming festivals fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page allowing mantra selection (persisted to backend when authenticated via Internet Identity, or localStorage otherwise), displaying jap stats, vrat mode toggle, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts, border radii, shadows, and background images for a Hindu religious app.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing a Hindu religious app with pending feature requests to add vrat kathayen, Ramayan/Mahabharat parvas, Krishna Leela stories, narration controls, and related UI enhancements.
